title: Pineapple Square Luncheon Set Pattern #7777
author: Spool Cotton Co., Spool Cotton #230 Featuring 14 New Pineapple Designs (via freevintagecrochet.com)
notes: Public domain vintage pattern. start: original "Starting at center, ch 8. Join." replaced by magic ring. Only the shell-lattice centre square, rnds 1-9 of the Centerpiece, kept (the pattern's Bread and Butter Plate Doily stops after rnd 8); rnds 10-15+ (written partly as 'complete rnd to correspond'/'continue in pattern'), the Pineapple Border (worked in rows) and the other doilies omitted. Rnds 3-9 don't say how to begin; the DSL starts them like rnd 2 (sl st to the shell sp, ch 3 = dc). Stitch graph: round 7 reads badly (cost 42.6); check where its stitches go.
